fennec_j: A baby fennec fox kit, tiny cream-colored body with oversized triangular ears already large relative to its head, black button nose, fluffy short fur, standing on all four legs
otter_j: A baby river otter pup, sleek brown fur still slightly fuzzy, short whiskered face, small webbed paws, sitting upright on a rock
kestrel_j: A fluffy kestrel chick, downy white and grey plumage, oversized dark eyes, short stubby wings, perched in a nest
hedgehog_j: A baby hedgehog, a tiny rounded ball-shaped animal whose entire back and sides are densely covered in soft pale quills packed close together like a pincushion, a small narrow tapering nose, tiny round ears, short stubby legs mostly hidden under the body, standing on all four legs. It is a hedgehog, not a pig: no pig snout, no flat round disc nose, no piglet body, no trotters, no curly tail.
gecko: A tokay gecko, blue-grey skin covered in orange-red spots, large round eyes with vertical pupils, adhesive toe pads, clinging to a branch
lovebird_j: A baby lovebird chick with clear baby proportions: an oversized round head that looks too big for its body, huge dark eyes, a short blunt hooked beak, a small body covered in wispy pale green down rather than smooth adult feathers, stubby undeveloped wings and almost no tail, crouched low and awkwardly on its feet. A helpless downy nestling, not a sleek fully-feathered adult parrot with long wings and a long tail.
rabbit_j: A young leveret, lanky long-eared brown hare baby with large amber eyes, longer legs than a rabbit kit, crouched low in grass
meerkat: A meerkat, slim upright body with tan and brown banded fur, dark eye patches, standing on hind legs on sentry duty, small clawed forepaws held to chest
dartfrog_j: A black tadpole with a rounded body and long translucent tail, no legs yet, resting in shallow water
dartfrog: A blue poison dart frog, vivid cobalt blue skin with black speckled legs, small and glossy, perched on a leaf, alert posture
beaver_j: A beaver kit, small rounded brown-furred body, tiny flat paddle tail, sitting upright on a log
flamingo: A greater flamingo, vivid pink plumage, long curved neck, black-tipped downturned bill, standing on one thin leg, wings folded
hippo: A hippopotamus, massive grey-brown barrel body, huge wide mouth, small ears and eyes on top of the head, standing on all four legs
croc_j: A newly hatched baby crocodile with clear baby proportions: an oversized head that looks too large for its small slender body, very large round eyes, a short blunt stubby snout, thin delicate little legs, bright yellow-and-black banding across a slim olive body and tail, standing on all four legs. A tiny hatchling with babyish oversized features, not a miniature version of a bulky heavy-jawed adult crocodile.
turtle: A red-eared slider terrapin, dark green domed shell with yellow markings, red stripe behind each eye, webbed feet, standing on all four legs
python: A ball python, thick-bodied snake with dark brown and tan blotched pattern, small head, coiled loosely on the ground
chameleon: A veiled chameleon, tall casque on its head, vivid green and yellow banded pattern, curled prehensile tail, gripping a branch with independently swiveling eyes
sloth: A three-toed sloth, shaggy long grey-brown fur, long curved claws, small flat face with a permanent gentle smile, hanging from a branch
hornbill: A great hornbill perched on a branch, with a heavy pale yellow bill and, sitting on top of the bill, a separate second block of horn: a large hollow flat-topped casque like a helmet or a second upturned bill stacked above the first, dark-edged and clearly distinct from the bill beneath it, so the head carries a double-decker outline. Black and white plumage, a long broad black-and-white tail, a thick heavy body. Not a toucan: the bill is not a smooth simple banana-shaped curve, and the head must not be bare on top.
jaguar_j: A jaguar cub, golden-tan fur covered in dark rosettes, oversized paws relative to its body, round face, standing on all four legs
tiger_j: A tiger cub, bright orange fur with bold black stripes, round fluffy face, oversized paws, standing on all four legs
sandcat: A sand cat, a small stocky wild desert cat with a distinctly broad flattened wide head, enormous triangular ears set low and wide apart on the sides of the head rather than on top, pale uniform sandy-buff fur with only very faint markings, a short stout body on short thick legs, thick fur between the toes, crouched low on desert sand. A wild sand cat, not a domestic tabby house cat: no bold tabby striping, no narrow domestic head, no tall upright ears on top of the head.
camel: A dromedary camel, single large fatty hump, short tan fur, long legs and neck, standing on all four legs
jackal: A golden jackal, slender tan-grey body with a black-tipped tail, pointed ears, standing on all four legs
tortoise: A sulcata tortoise, large domed tan-brown shell with pronounced growth rings, thick spurred legs, standing on all four legs
caracal: A caracal standing on all four legs, a slender reddish-tan short-furred cat with very long dramatic black tufts rising from the ear tips like tall thin plumes, and a distinctly SHORT tail reaching only about a third of the way to the ground, not a long sweeping cat tail
cobra_j: A newly hatched cobra coiled loosely on the ground, a very small slender olive-green snake with hatchling proportions: an oversized blunt head that looks too large for its thin little body, very large round eyes, and a hood only barely flared. A tiny hatchling, not a full-grown adult cobra with a wide spread hood
scorpion: An emperor scorpion, glossy black segmented body, large pincers, curved tail with a stinger arched over its back
boar_j: A wild boar piglet, small reddish-brown body with pale horizontal stripes along its back, short legs, standing on all four legs
badger_j: A honey badger cub with clear baby proportions: an oversized rounded head that looks too large for its small body, very large round eyes, a short blunt muzzle, short stubby legs and soft fluffy baby fur, a chubby rounded youngster and not a miniature scaled-down adult, with grey-backed black-bellied fur and small blunt claws, standing on all four legs
pangolin: A ground pangolin, body covered in overlapping brown keratin scales, long snout, curled tail, standing on all four legs
ibex: An Alpine ibex, sturdy brown-grey goat with massive backward-curving ridged horns, standing on all four legs
hyena_j: A spotted hyena cub with clear baby proportions: an oversized rounded head that looks too large for its small body, very large round eyes, a short blunt muzzle, short stubby legs and soft fluffy baby fur, a chubby rounded youngster and not a miniature scaled-down adult, with a dark blackish-brown fuzzy coat not yet showing spots and rounded ears, standing on all four legs
wilddog_j: An African wild dog pup with clear baby proportions: an oversized rounded head that looks too large for its small body, very large round eyes, a short blunt muzzle, short stubby legs and soft fluffy baby fur, a chubby rounded youngster and not a miniature scaled-down adult, with patchy black brown and white fur and large rounded ears, standing on all four legs
serval: A serval, tall slender cat with golden fur covered in bold black spots, very large rounded ears, long legs, standing on all four legs
aardvark: An aardvark, stocky greyish-brown body, long tubular snout, large rabbit-like ears, thick tail, standing on all four legs
arcticfox_j: An Arctic fox kit, fluffy pale grey-brown fur, small rounded ears, bushy tail, standing on all four legs
lynx_j: A lynx kitten, thick pale grey-brown fur with faint spots, tufted ears just growing in, oversized paws, standing on all four legs
snowleopard_j: A snow leopard cub with clear baby proportions: an oversized rounded head that looks too large for its small body, very large round eyes, a short blunt muzzle, short stubby legs and soft fluffy baby fur, a chubby rounded youngster and not a miniature scaled-down adult, with thick smoky-grey fur, dark rosettes and a thick fluffy tail, standing on all four legs
penguin: An African penguin, black and white tuxedo plumage, pink patches above the eyes, black band across the white chest, standing upright on rocks
seal: A Cape fur seal, sleek brown-grey body, pointed muzzle, external ear flaps, propped up on its front flippers on a rock
monitor: A rock monitor lizard with its body held low and horizontal, belly close to the ground, all four sturdy clawed legs splayed out to the sides in a sprawling reptile stance, a long heavy tail trailing flat along the ground behind it, robust grey-brown body with faint banding and a long forked tongue. Low and horizontal like a real monitor lizard, not rearing up on its hind legs and not standing upright like a dinosaur
vulture: A white-backed vulture, dark brown plumage, bald pinkish head and neck, broad wings folded
bat: An Egyptian fruit bat hanging upside down from a branch with its wings folded closed at its sides, having a long fox-like muzzle and a dog-like face, large dark eyes and upright pointed ears, brown fur. Its head is shaped like a small fox or dog, not a round mouse-like or humanlike face
owl_j: A fluffy owlet perched low and clumsily on a branch, with clear baby proportions: an oversized round head far too big for its small body, huge yellow eyes, a tiny beak, a body covered in soft white-grey natal down rather than smooth adult feathers, no ear tufts at all, and stubby undeveloped wings. A downy nestling, not a small adult owl
galago: A greater galago, soft grey fur, enormous round eyes, huge bat-like ears, long bushy tail, clinging upright to a branch
redfox_j: A red fox kit with clear baby proportions: an oversized rounded head that looks too large for its small body, very large round eyes, a short blunt muzzle, short stubby legs and soft fluffy baby fur, a chubby rounded youngster and not a miniature scaled-down adult, with fluffy reddish-brown fur and a white-tipped tail just forming, standing on all four legs
manedwolf_j: A maned wolf pup with clear baby proportions: an oversized rounded head that looks too large for its small body, very large round eyes, a short blunt muzzle, short stubby legs and soft fluffy baby fur, a chubby rounded youngster and not a miniature scaled-down adult, with dark blackish fur and large ears, its legs still short and stubby rather than long, standing on all four legs
wolf_j: A grey wolf pup, fluffy grey-brown fur, oversized paws, round blue eyes, standing on all four legs
leopard_j: A leopard cub, tawny fur with dark rosettes still soft and fuzzy, round face, standing on all four legs
lion_j: A lion cub, sandy-golden fur with faint dark spots that fade with age, round tufted ears, standing on all four legs
cheetah_j: A cheetah cub with clear baby proportions: an oversized rounded head that looks too large for its small body, very large round eyes, a short blunt muzzle, short stubby legs and soft fluffy baby fur, a chubby rounded youngster and not a miniature scaled-down adult, with a pale grey-blue fuzzy mantle running down its back over spotted tan fur, exactly two front legs and exactly two back legs clearly separated, standing on all four legs
pallascat: A Pallas's cat crouched low on rocky ground, with extremely dense long grey fur, a broad flattened round face, and small rounded ears set very LOW and WIDE on the sides of the head almost level with the eyes, so the top of the head reads as a flat unbroken curve with nothing sticking up. Stocky low-slung body on short legs. Not a longhaired domestic cat: no tall pointed ears on top of the head
puma: A puma, uniform tawny-brown short-furred body, small rounded head, long thick tail, standing on all four legs
ocelot: An ocelot, golden-tan fur covered in dark chain-like rosettes and stripes, standing on all four legs
cloudedleopard: A clouded leopard standing on all four legs, its grey-tan fur marked with very large irregular cloud-shaped blotches, each a big soft-edged patch outlined with a dark border and filled with a darker tan centre, like drifting clouds or camouflage patches. Short legs and a very long thick tail. The markings must be large irregular outlined cloud shapes, not small round solid spots
fishingcat: A fishing cat standing on all four legs, a stocky heavily-built cat with a deep chest and short thick legs, olive-grey fur with small dark spots in neat rows, a distinctly SHORT thick tail about a third of its body length, partially webbed paws and a broad blunt muzzle. Robust and chunky, not a slender long-tailed domestic cat
jaguarundi: A jaguarundi standing on all four legs, an unusual otter-like cat with a very long low slender body, short legs, a small narrow flattened head with small rounded ears, and a very long tail. Its fur is a completely uniform solid slate-grey over the entire animal including the head and face, with no markings, no spots and no pale or white patches anywhere. Low and elongated like an otter, and its head must be exactly the same colour as its body
margay: A margay crouched on all four paws along a thick tree branch, gripping the branch with all four feet, its body low and horizontal above the branch, golden fur with dark rosettes, large eyes, and a very long tail hanging down for balance. On four legs on the branch, not standing upright on two legs, and not holding or carrying a stick or a staff
bobcat: A bobcat standing on all four legs, reddish-brown fur with faint dark spots, black-tufted ears, and a very SHORT stubby bobbed tail only a few inches long held up clear of the ground, not a long sweeping cat tail
marbledcat: A marbled cat standing on all four legs, its thick soft grey-brown fur patterned with large irregular blotches outlined in dark edges and joined together into a swirling marbled pattern like polished stone, not small round separate dots, with a very long thick bushy tail as long as its body
blackfootedcat: A black-footed cat crouched low on sand, the smallest African wild cat: a tiny compact stocky little cat with a rounded head, short legs and a short tail, sandy-tan fur covered in bold black blotches and bars, and black undersides to the paws. Very small and squat, not a long-legged elegant spotted cat
rustyspottedcat: A rusty-spotted cat standing on all four legs, the smallest cat in the world: a tiny delicate cat with a small rounded head, big eyes, short legs and a short tail, greyish fur marked with rows of small rust-brown blotches along the back and flanks only, its face and legs plain. Tiny and slight, not a normal-sized domestic tabby
kodkod: A kodkod standing on all four legs, a very small South American cat with a small rounded head, large eyes, short legs and a short thick tail, its grey-brown fur covered in small dense dark spots. Tiny, not a normal-sized house cat
andeancat: An Andean mountain cat standing on all four legs, a stocky mountain cat with thick pale silver-grey fur, faint rusty-brown blotches on the flanks, and a very thick heavy bushy tail almost as long as its body, ringed with bold dark bands and carried low. The tail must be thick and plush like a snow leopard's, not a thin tabby tail
asiangoldencat: An Asian golden cat standing on all four legs, a solidly built medium-large wild cat with a deep chest and heavy limbs, uniform golden-brown fur with no spots, and bold white and black stripes running across the cheeks and from the inner corner of each eye up over the forehead. Large and powerful, not a ginger domestic house cat
jungle_cat: A jungle cat standing on all four legs, a tall long-legged sandy-tan cat with a slim body, small dark tufts on the ear tips, and a relatively short tail with dark rings near its black tip, faint dark bars only on the legs
tibetanfox: A Tibetan sand fox standing on all four legs, whose face is distinctly SQUARE: a broad flat rectangular head with a wide blunt boxy muzzle and a thick ruff of fur widening the cheeks, so the head reads as a rectangle or a box with small ears set high on the corners, giving a deadpan narrow-eyed expression. Greyish-tan body and a thick bushy grey-tipped tail. The muzzle must be square and blunt, not a pointed triangular fox snout
dingo: A dingo, lean ginger-tan short-furred body, upright ears, bushy tail, standing alert in dry grassland
dhole: A dhole, rusty-red short fur, bushy black-tipped tail, rounded ears, standing on all four legs
coyote: A coyote standing on all four legs, a slender lightly-built canid noticeably lean and narrow through the chest, with long thin legs, a narrow sharply pointed muzzle, large pointed ears that look big for its head, grizzled grey-tan fur, and a bushy black-tipped tail carried low and pointing downward. Slim and delicate, not a thick heavy wolf
bateared: A bat-eared fox, small tan-grey body with enormous rounded ears, black legs, standing in short grass. Plain empty white background: no grey panel, no box, no square backdrop, no border, no ground, no scenery of any kind behind the animal.
grayfox: A gray fox standing on all four legs, with grizzled salt-and-pepper grey fur, rusty-orange on the neck chest and legs, short legs and a compact low body, and a bushy tail carried straight out with a distinct black stripe of coarse hair running along the top of the tail to a black tip
corsacfox: A corsac fox standing on all four legs, a small compact fox with a rounded head, large upright ears, short legs and a low body, pale sandy-grey fur and a short bushy tail. Small and compact, not a tall wolf-like canid
swiftfox: A swift fox, small buff-colored fox with a black-tipped tail, large ears, standing on all four legs
culpeo: A culpeo fox, reddish-grey fur with a dark stripe down its back, bushy tail with a black tip, standing on all four legs
bushdog: A bush dog, compact stocky reddish-brown body, short legs, small rounded ears, short tail, standing on all four legs
raccoondog: A raccoon dog standing on all four legs, a small very rotund short-legged animal shaped like a fat round barrel of thick fur, its plump low body almost brushing the ground, with very short stubby legs, a small pointed face wearing a black raccoon-like mask, small rounded ears and a short bushy tail. Squat and round like a tanuki, not a tall long-legged wolf or dog
ethiopianwolf: An Ethiopian wolf, slender reddish coat with white throat and underparts, long legs, pointed muzzle, standing on all four legs
blackbackjackal: A black-backed jackal, rusty-tan body with a black and silver saddle across the back, standing on all four legs
aardwolf: An aardwolf, pale yellowish fur with vertical dark stripes, sloped back, small head, erect mane along the spine, standing on all four legs
stripedhyena: A striped hyena standing on all four legs seen from the side, with the unmistakable hyena silhouette: tall powerful front legs and high muscular shoulders, the back sloping steeply downward to noticeably lower and shorter hindquarters so the rump sits far below the shoulders. Shaggy grey fur with vertical black stripes, a tall erect mane of long hair along the neck and spine, and a large blunt head. The steeply sloping back is essential and it must not be level-backed like a wolf
brownhyena: A brown hyena standing on all four legs seen from the side, with the unmistakable hyena silhouette: high muscular shoulders and long front legs, the back sloping steeply down to much lower hindquarters. Long shaggy dark brown fur hanging in a cape over the shoulders, pale horizontally striped legs, and a large blunt head. The steeply sloping back is essential and it must not be level-backed like a wolf or a lion
binturong: A binturong, shaggy coarse black fur, whiskered face, long thick prehensile tail, gripping a branch
civet: An African civet standing on all four legs, a long-bodied low-slung animal with short legs, a long pointed snout, coarse grey fur covered in rows of black spots and blotches, a black facial mask, and a thick bushy ringed tail. Long and low to the ground, not a cat
genet: A common genet standing on all four legs, an extremely long and low animal with a very elongated slim body and very short legs so its belly runs close to the ground, a small narrow head with a sharply pointed snout and large rounded ears, pale fur covered in neat rows of dark spots, and an extremely long ringed tail as long as its body. Long and low like a weasel, not a leggy spotted cat
fossa: A fossa standing on all four legs, a long low muscular predator with an elongated body, short legs, a small rounded head with a short blunt slightly dog-like muzzle and small rounded ears, uniform reddish-brown short fur, and an extremely long thick tail as long as its entire body. Long and low to the ground, not a lean upright cougar
mongoose: A dwarf mongoose on all four legs with its body held low and horizontal close to the ground, a small slender brown body, a long tapering tail trailing behind it, short legs and a small pointed face. On all fours in a low horizontal posture, not standing upright on its hind legs and not an upright human-like figure
linsang: A banded linsang standing on all four legs, a very long low slender animal with short legs, a small narrow pointed head, pale yellow fur crossed by bold wide black bands, and a very long tail ringed with black. Long and low to the ground, not a leggy cat
grizzly: A grizzly bear, massive brown-furred body with a distinctive shoulder hump, long claws, standing on all fours on grass
polarbear: A polar bear, thick creamy-white fur, stocky powerful build, black nose, standing on all four legs
blackbear: An American black bear, glossy black fur, tan snout, rounded ears, standing on all fours in a forest clearing
panda: A giant panda, round white body with black patches over the eyes, ears, and limbs, sitting upright chewing bamboo
spectacledbear: A spectacled bear, shaggy black fur with pale tan markings around the eyes like spectacles, standing on all fours in misty forest
slothbear: A sloth bear, shaggy long black fur, pale U-shaped chest marking, long curved claws, elongated snout, standing on all four legs
moonbear: An Asian black bear, glossy black fur with a pale crescent moon-shaped chest marking, rounded ears, standing on all fours
sunbear: A sun bear, short sleek black fur, distinctive orange-tan crescent chest marking, long claws, standing on all fours
raccoon: A raccoon, grey-furred body with a black facial mask and a bushy ringed tail, standing on all fours near a stream
redpanda: A red panda, rusty-red fur, ringed bushy tail, white-marked face, standing on all four legs
coati: A white-nosed coati seen from the side walking on all four legs, with EXACTLY ONE tail: a single long slender tail, held straight up stiffly vertical like a flagpole, faintly ringed with darker bands. It has one tail only, a single unbranched tail, with no second tail, no forked tail and no extra banded limb anywhere on its body. Its body is long low and tubular like a raccoon's, carried close to the ground on short legs, walking flat-footed on the whole soles of its feet like a small bear, with a grizzled warm reddish-brown coat of banded agouti hairs, a distinctly WHITE muzzle with white markings ringing the eyes and edging the cheeks, small rounded ears set low, and a very long flexible upturned pig-like snout projecting well past the mouth and tipped upward. A low heavy-bodied raccoon relative, not a slim arch-backed marten and not a pointed-faced fox
